The '''[[HM-8]] concussion missile tube launcher''' was a [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]] manufactured by [[Dymek/Legends|Dymek]]. [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] was equipped with two such launchers.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />
